newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia '97 GDP may rise 7-8 pct - Premier.
newsitem.headline: Croatia '97 GDP may rise 7-8 pct - Premier.

text.p: Croatian Prime Minister Zlatko Matesa said on Friday Croatia's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) may rise in 1997 by seven to eight percent.
He told a news conference current forecasts put the rise of this year's industrial output at six percent.
Matesa said the industrial output in the first six months of this year was 10.7 percent up on the same period last year.
"The forecast based on this data says the industrial output should rise by six percent and the GDP by 7-8 percent. This a very conservative estimate," he told reporters.
